description: Plan and optionally execute saved test cases for a natural-language request. Reuses explicit saved steps, supports a plan-only preview, captures screenshot evidence for failed steps, and writes per-case plus aggregate reports. This tool does not invent missing tests or claim skipped work passed.

assertionTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for an explicit expectedOutcome to appear; default 3000ms. UI actions are not retried.

base.description: Git base ref for change context; defaults to HEAD~1.

execute.description: Default false: return a reviewable plan only. Set true to execute selected saved cases.

request.description: What changed or what behavior should be tested.

targetId.description: Android target for execution; required when more than one device is connected.

name: run_test_workflow
title: Run Change-Aware Test Workflow
